subject: per-vt-u-fund
title: PER.VT.U.FUND.------COS.P.
description: Diagram in UPB(II)-6, on the page where Braxton argues that 'creativity is not separate from the underlying factors which dictate how we move in vibrational and cosmic terms in our actual lives... what is really happening is cosmic.' (C)PER-VT-U-FUND — the *perceived* vibrational universe fundamental, the limit of what humans can apprehend of the universe's vibrational ground — is crossed with COS-P (cosmic particulars). The diagram poses: how does the *perceived* fundamental relate to actual cosmic particulars when the human apparatus of perception is itself involved? Three upstream feeds converge on the subject: COS-P (the crossing partner), HI-P (high purpose), and AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) — and AFL-DY also feeds TR (transformation) directly. INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis) also feeds the subject and separately branches to IF-SPT (infra-spirituality). PER-VT-U-FUND outputs to DYM-SPT (dynamic spiritualism) and MT-INFO (music information). Structural argument: the perceived vibrational fundamental is over-determined — three independent upstream feeds (cosmic particulars, high purpose, affinity dynamics) and a fourth (information affinity basis), with affinity dynamics also routing directly to transformation. Music information and dynamic spiritualism are the only outputs, suggesting Braxton's claim that perception of the cosmic ground gives rise to music and to dynamic-spiritualism as twin channels — not to anything else.
